description: This file contains helper functions used in unit testing for the kuksa-val project. It includes functions for verifying timestamps, packing data into JSON format, and references various external libraries such as Boost and jsoncons.

methods.name: void verify_timestamp(const jsoncons::json & result)
methods.description: Verifies that a JSON result contains a 'ts' key with a string value matching an ISO timestamp pattern.

methods.name: void verify_timestampZero(const jsoncons::json & result)
methods.description: Verifies that a JSON result contains a 'ts' key with a string value matching an ISO timestamp pattern and equals the zero timestamp.

methods.name: void verify_and_erase_timestamp(jsoncons::json & result)
methods.description: Verifies timestamp existence and erases the 'ts' key for comparison purposes.

methods.name: void verify_and_erase_timestampZero(jsoncons::json & result)
methods.description: Verifies timestamp zero and erases the 'ts' key for comparison.

methods.name: jsoncons::json packDataInJson(const VSSPath & path,const std::string & value)
methods.description: Packs VSSPath and string value into a JSON object with a timestamp, used for testing data serialization.

ctags.name: packDataInJson
ctags.pattern: /^static inline jsoncons::json packDataInJson(const VSSPath& path, const std::string& value) { $/
